text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the end of the year, an invitation to a "Christmas Party"
arrived from Seeking the Pearl.
Following the directions to the venue—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
“—There you are, Trainer.
Hehe, right on time.”

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"I bet you're thinking,
'Why? A party in a place like this?!' aren't you!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho!
Ohoooohohohohohoooo!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
—Come on!
Our wings, here to grace this evening!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rattle rattle rattle rattle rattle rattle rattle rattle...)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... I chartered it
using Poppy's connections.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's take flight!
To gaze upon the brilliant Christmas Eve nightscape...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, I was ushered into a seat,
and when I came to, I was soaring through a sea of stars—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"I really wanted to show you this.
A familiar view can look just like jewelry
if you change your perspective, don't you think?"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The lights from shops, houses, offices—all the little lights
from so many people... Every single one can become a beautiful jewel...
choice_data_list: I see, that's another possibility, huh.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...Oh! Yes! Exactly right!
Hehe, you understand without me even having to say it!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Alright, we're almost there...
To tonight's main activity!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after a brief flight,
the place we landed in was...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
WAAAAAOOOH!!
Pearl-senpai arrived in a helicopteeeer!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you joining us as well, Trainer?
It somehow reminds me of the parties back home.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I understand completely, desu!
El's mama and papa always went arm-in-arm to home parties together, desu!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
That's a common sight in the West, after all.
Hehe, that's so like Pearl-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Merry Christmas, everyone!
White pearls are falling from the sky!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Awesome!!
You don't even see hero shows dropping in from the sky!
Pearl-senpai is so gorgeous!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Did both of you come in your gym clothes?
Could it be that you just finished training?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, bingo~☆
I was running outta time,
so I just rushed over like this...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, my bad.
I should've dressed up nicer to come here...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"No, no problem! Totally okay, in fact!
In case something like this happened—"

text_block_list.name: 2 people
text_block_list.text:
Uwoooh!
Whoaaa!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~! You prepared this for me~!?
It's so cute~~♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! Thank you so much!
It really feels like a party all of a sudden!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu...!
Looks like the voltage has risen even higher...♪
choice_data_list: As expected, you're always so well-prepared...!
As expected, you're always so well-prepared...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's only natural consideration as a host.
All to make this wonderful party a reality.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I wanted to make the greatest memories with the friends I feel destiny with...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And! I wanted to create a fitting venue
so that everyone could get to know you much better!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Because you are the Trainer I'm so proud of!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that's why you set up a place like this.
Is the secret to your strength... him?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that's why you set up a place like this.
Is the secret to your strength... her?

—She is Grass Wonder.
An American-born Yamato Nadeshiko, an Umamusume of unwavering inner strength and undeniable talent.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It wouldn't be an exaggeration to say so.
Fufu... seems you're interested, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course I'm curious about the strong ones.
The paths they have walked, and the destinations they strive for...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Because going forward,
I might be asking for your guidance too.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That fighting spirit is good...!
Okay! Let's talk a whole lot tonight!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Come on, everyone!
The party is starting!

And so, Christmas night
lively drew to a close.

It was the rooftop of a luxury hotel.
The moment she stepped downstairs from the roof, she spoke.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The night view isn't the only gift!
Here's a special Christmas dinner,
for you!!
choice_data_list: S-Such an expensive gift from a student...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
No problem!
Mommy made the reservation and said,
'Please invite him, since he always takes such good care of you.'

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
No problem!
Mommy made the reservation and said,
'Please invite her, since she always takes such good care of you.'

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: My Papi and Mami often get transferred overseas, so they seem to see you, who supports me right by my side, as someone truly special...♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Turning down this 'thank you' is no good!
It just shows how grateful they truly are."
choice_data_list: ...All right. If that's the case, let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, looks like you understand.
That's right, you're a wonderful person
who deserves to receive a special gift.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Because you have always supported me,
running alongside me all the way here...!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now then, follow my lead.
Shall we enjoy a romantic evening tonight?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
—Well then, Trainer.
Cheers to the beautiful night view, and to this holy Christmas Eve.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~, this year's sparkling
carrot juice turned out quite splendidly...♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This rich terroir, this fresh sweetness...
Could it be from Normandy?

text_block_list.name: Sommelier
text_block_list.text:
...Correct! As always,
your palate is truly remarkable.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, I've been drinking this often since I was a child.
Something like this is easy for me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"What kind of flavor do you prefer?
I'll select the second bottle for you."

"And as the after-dinner coffee was served, I brought out the gift I had prepared.
Handing it over, I felt a little nervous."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh my...!
Did you prepare a present for me as well?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
choice_data_list: (Maybe I should've splurged a bit more...!)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Thaaank yooou!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
“A ‘humble’ gift... you say?
If it is a gift from you, it is precious to me beyond measure.”

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: As you can see, I am a gorgeous Umamusume, but gifts do not need to be the same...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Because... it's the thought that counts!
And the time you spent agonizing over it for me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Because all of it will create
the absolute best experience for you and me...!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, fufufufu...!
Hey, is it okay if I open it right away?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Wow!! Amazing!!

And so, the fabulous and romantic Christmas
night wore on...
